en: And with all of that, I wanna say thank you
for being part of the course. I hope you
learned a lot about writing clean code and
why it matters.
And always keep in mind,
writing clean code is an iterative process.
You will not be able to look at all these
rules and apply them
right from the start whenever you start
working on a new project.
Instead, be patient. And apply them over
time. Always question your existing code and
try to improve it over time.
And also don't treat all these rules and
concepts taught in this course as hard
rules. Don't split every function 10 times
just because you can do it.
As I mentioned in the course,
do all of that with some common sense
because ultimately you should always keep in
mind
clean code is about code which is easy to
read and understand. And if you achieve
that, and if not just you but also your
colleagues share this opinion,
then everything is good.
And that's the course. As I said, I hope you
got a lot out of it, and maybe I can welcome
you in other courses as well.
Bye!
